change.purpose: Operator report 2026-09-26: 'ChatGPT har uppdaterat sitt UI så EIC startas inte upp längre vid start av kö. Greenfield defaultar till ChatGPT standard chatt istället för EIC.' Screenshots: overlay 'SENDING · GF-045 · Spärr: EIC_SURFACE_UNVERIFIED' on standard chat; EIC selected at chatgpt.com/ with composer pill 'EIC'. Follow-up screenshot: new processing notice 'Planerade åtkomst / Våra system bearbetar den här begäran lite till innan de svarar.'
change.rootCause: (1) activateQueueItem resolved the queue slot's GPT root with deriveGptRoot(tab.url, priorProcess.gptRoot); a tab at chatgpt.com/ (where ChatGPT's newer shell shows a pinned GPT after a client-side selection) with no prior custom root gave the generic root 'https://chatgpt.com/', and the rotation navigated there: standard chat. lastKnownGoodEicUrl was not consulted. (2) tickRotating accepted any fresh chat (userCount 0, composer ready) as the landing, so SENDING began in standard chat and the send-time proof held EIC_SURFACE_UNVERIFIED. (3) GPT identity was compared by the full path segment including the name slug; the newer shell's URLs omit it (/g/g-<id>/c/<conv> instead of /g/g-<id>-eic/c/<conv>), so EIC conversations classified as WRONG_CUSTOM_GPT/EIC_SURFACE_UNVERIFIED. (4) content.js matched the processing notice only with 'förfrågan'; the newer wording 'begäran' with a status heading became assistant text ('Planerade åtkomstVåra system bearbetar …').
change.fix: lib/safety-policy.js: gptRef/sameGpt (identity = g-<id> token), eicSurfaceProof (URL with /g/: id must match; generic URL: composer pill/header GPT name must slugify to the expected root's slug; conflict, ambiguity or no name = EIC_SURFACE_UNVERIFIED), used by evaluateModel. lib/managed-eic-surface.mjs: identity-based classify, preferNamedRoot, resolveManagedGptRoot (tab GPT -> process GPT -> last verified EIC, never generic); rememberGoodEicUrl never replaces a named root by a slugless one of the same GPT. lib/session-rotation.mjs deriveGptRoot keeps the named root. lib/model-observation.js: gptSurface {composerName, headerName} (adapterVersion stays 5). content.js: EIC_GF_SELECT_GPT clicks the unique pinned GPT (section Pinned) by name, never the unpin button or a recent chat; processing notice 'begäran' and a lone status heading next to the notice are status. background.js: queue start throws EIC_GPT_ROOT_UNKNOWN instead of using a generic root; tickRotating landing check (slugless address, then up to 3 pinned-GPT clicks 4 s apart, BLOCKED SESSION_ROTATION_EIC_NOT_SELECTED after 120 s); surface guard accepts EIC shown by name at '/', and does not navigate during ROTATING; startRun accepts EIC shown by name at '/'; restart recovery and rebind compare GPT identity.
